articles.summary: The United States men's national team secured a crushing 6-0 victory over Haiti in the first leg of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinals on Saturday night.
articles.content: The United States men's national team delivered a crushing blow to Haiti, securing a 6-0 victory in the first leg of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinals held in Miami on Saturday night. Christian Pulisic made an immediate impact, scoring two goals within a short span of just two minutes. This decisive win marked a significant margin of victory for Mauricio Pochettino's team under his leadership. The outcome sets up a formality for the return leg in Cincinnati on Tuesday, where Pochettino will be at the helm for the final time as coach. The team's dominant performance suggests that they are well-prepared to face the change in leadership, with Pochettino departing after only three months of his four-year contract to take over as manager of Manchester United. Players like Auston Trusty remained focused on their departing coach, demonstrating a sense of loyalty and commitment. In an interview with TNT, Trusty acknowledged the team's dedication: "We played for him. The USMNT's 6-0 thrashing of Haiti has been marked by a sense of dedication and purpose, as players have continued to play for their departing coach. Despite the uncertainty surrounding his future, the team remains focused on winning every game and fighting until the end. Trusty, a key figure in the team, acknowledged this commitment: We played for him." The team's determination was evident in their performance, which saw them take control of the match from the outset. Pulisic made a triumphant return to action after recovering from an injury suffered during the World Cup. His two second-half goals secured his position as fourth on the team's all-time leading scorers list, surpassing Eric Wynalda's record. The USMNT's attacking prowess was on full display as they scored five more goals in the second half, with Weston McKennie and Folarin Balogun joining Pulisic on the scoresheet. The match against Haiti provided a unique opportunity for the USMNT to showcase their skills in a high-pressure environment. Despite being technically the home team, Haiti's ongoing gang violence led to the fixture being moved to Miami. The change of venue did not seem to faze the USMNT players, who executed a well-planned strategy that left little room for error. The outcome was never in doubt as the USMNT dominated the match from start to finish. Teenager Julian Hall also contributed to the team's goal tally with his fourth strike, demonstrating the depth of talent within the squad. The win has sent a strong message about the team's capabilities and commitment to excellence, even in uncertain circumstances. The USMNT's convincing 6-0 victory over Haiti has sparked excitement and anticipation among fans, but the spotlight is now on the team's leadership. With the current coach's future uncertain, attention turns to finding a new manager who can guide the team forward. Reports suggest that the United States Soccer Federation is actively pursuing Pep Guardiola, with initial negotiations expected to begin next week. Guardiola has been a highly sought-after free agent since leaving Manchester City in May 2026, having accumulated an impressive 41 trophies over his 19-year European managing career. The federation aims to finalize a deal with a new manager before the team's next international camp in December, giving them time to prepare for their remaining Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal matches. articles.content: The highly anticipated matchup between the Pittsburgh Steelers and Cincinnati Bengals is set to conclude the 10th Sunday of the NFL's regular season in a battle for first place in the AFC North division. Pittsburgh currently holds a narrow lead over its rival Cincinnati, thanks to a Week 5 victory that gave them an edge. The Steelers have dominated their head-to-head matchups against the Bengals, winning seven out of nine games since the start of the 2022 season. However, Cincinnati did manage to snap this streak in their last meeting at home. The second loss for Pittsburgh came in the form of a narrow defeat to the Bengals in October, with the final score being 33-31. But the Steelers were able to bounce back and secure a win just a month later when they hosted the game at Heinz Field. The key factor in Pittsburgh's previous victory was the performance of Jaylen Warren, who rushed for an impressive 127 yards on 17 carries and also caught three passes for 49 yards. articles.title: PlayStation Console Controllers May Integrate Credit Card Reader
articles.summary: A recent patent filing suggests Sony's next-generation controllers may include a credit card reader for seamless digital purchases.
articles.content: A recent patent filing by Sony suggests a new direction for its console controllers. The "Video game controller-driven information transfer" patent proposes integrating a credit card reader into the PlayStation controller, enabling users to access their nearby phone to send payment details or account information directly to the console. The move would simplify the checkout process for digital games, eliminating one more step in the process of purchasing and playing content. This aligns with Sony's decision to shift entirely to digital formats by 2028, when it will discontinue physical disc production. In this digital-only age, convenience is becoming increasingly important. The introduction of a tap-friendly credit card reader on a controller would mirror technology found on smartphones and in grocery stores. This innovation could potentially make it easier for users to access their accounts and send payment details directly from their phone to the console, streamlining the checkout process. While this patent filing hints at new features coming to future PlayStation consoles, its success is yet to be determined. Other recent patents, such as Microsoft's plan to interrupt games with ads, have sparked debate about the direction of next-generation gaming. The patent application from Sony suggests that its next-generation controllers could integrate a credit card reader, allowing users to make purchases directly from their console. The proposed system would involve a controller detecting nearby devices, such as a phone, and then receiving confirmation before transmitting the payment information to the console. This proximity detection technology is not new; it's based on NFC (near-field communication), which enables contactless payments across various devices, including iPhones and Apple Watches. Some gaming controllers have already utilized NFC for scanning amiibos, like the Wii U GamePad and Nintendo Switch Pro Controller. The patent describes how these messages would be triggered by events occurring at the console, such as buying a game or entering gift card details. The diagrams accompanying the patent suggest that users could complete these transactions with just a tap of their device, eliminating the need to navigate through payment menus on their phone. This streamlined process aims to make purchasing games and other items from the PlayStation Store more convenient for both gamers and Sony. By avoiding the hassle of scrolling through phones or searching for card numbers, users are less likely to abandon their carts and lose potential sales. The proposed feature would not only enable users to make payments through their PlayStation controller but also streamline the login process. According to patent diagrams, tapping on the credit card reader could grant access to a user's account without needing to manually enter credentials. This streamlined login method would eliminate the need for one-time guest profiles and make it easier for users to switch between accounts. The existing passkey option already simplifies this process but still requires more steps than a simple tap. articles.title: Portable Computing with External Graphics Cards Faces Limitations
articles.summary: A new trend in portable computing is emerging, where users can connect a powerful external graphics card to their laptop for improved performance.
articles.content: A new trend in portable computing is emerging, where users can connect a powerful external graphics card to their laptop for improved performance. This setup seems like a clever solution to one of the oldest problems in mobile computing: how to get desktop-class graphics on-the-go without sacrificing portability. However, there are several limitations that need to be considered before making such an investment. One major issue is the bandwidth bottleneck caused by using Thunderbolt or USB4 cables to connect the external GPU. This can significantly reduce the performance advantage of the desktop card compared to a built-in laptop GPU with direct internal connection. When comparing onboard and external GPUs, it's essential to note that "onboard" refers specifically to a dedicated GPU built into the laptop, not integrated graphics shared with the processor. Even when laptops and desktops share similar-sounding GPU names, their hardware can be quite different in terms of specifications and capabilities. The NVIDIA RTX 5090 Laptop GPU boasts 10,496 CUDA cores and 24GB of GDDR7 memory, operating within a power range of 95W to 150W. In contrast, its desktop counterpart features an impressive 21,760 CUDA cores and 32GB of GDDR7 memory, showcasing a substantial gap in performance potential before even accounting for potential bottlenecks such as Thunderbolt limitations. The limitation of external graphics processing units (eGPUs) lies in their connection to laptops via Thunderbolt or USB4, rather than a direct PCIe bus link. This indirect connection creates a bottleneck that can significantly impact performance. Internal laptop GPUs, on the other hand, utilize an internal PCIe connection, which offers more bandwidth and flexibility. The latest Thunderbolt 5 technology boasts a base speed of 80 Gbps, but it still requires 64 Gbps of PCIe data throughput to function efficiently. The difference between desktop and laptop graphics cards becomes apparent when considering their raw hardware capabilities. A powerful desktop card like NVIDIA's RTX 5090 has significantly more memory bandwidth and power than its laptop counterpart, the RTX 5090 Laptop GPU. The limitations of eGPUs are further highlighted by the fact that even Thunderbolt 5's Bandwidth Boost mode doesn't provide a direct 120 Gbps PCIe connection. Intel clarifies that PCIe data throughput remains at 64 Gbps in this mode, which is still a bottleneck compared to internal laptop GPUs. For an eGPU setup to work seamlessly, not only does the host hardware need to support it, but also the enclosure, drivers, GPU, and power requirements must all be compatible. A USB-C port alone is not enough to guarantee eGPU compatibility. When using an external graphics processing unit (eGPU) connected via a laptop's display, performance can suffer due to the limited bandwidth required to transmit rendered frames back through the same connection. This limitation is further exacerbated when the eGPU is connected through a USB-C port alone, which may not guarantee compatibility. It's worth noting that some manufacturers recommend connecting an external monitor directly to the eGPU for improved performance. The inherent design of a laptop graphics processing unit (GPU) offers several advantages over its desktop counterpart. For instance, it operates within the laptop's power and cooling constraints, eliminating the need to send rendered frames back through an external cable. In contrast, using a traditional desktop-card eGPU can introduce new variables that affect portability. The enclosure, desktop GPU, and potentially even an ATX power supply take up desk space, adding size and noise to the setup. The cost of incorporating an eGPU into a laptop gaming experience is also worth considering. For example, Razer's Thunderbolt 5 Core X V2 supports full-size NVIDIA and AMD desktop cards but requires additional expenses for the GPU itself and a necessary ATX power supply. Upgrading your laptop's graphics capabilities can be a cost-effective option if you already have a suitable GPU from a desktop upgrade. This is because the enclosure can significantly enhance your laptop's performance without the need to purchase an entirely new computer. However, purchasing a high-end desktop card specifically for eGPU use may not be justifiable, especially when considering the cost of the power and potential limitations in cable connectivity that might restrict full utilization of the GPU's capabilities.
